title: A Multi-Dimensional Audit of Politically Aligned Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper uses Jürgen Habermas’ Theory of Communicative Action as an ethical framework for its audit, specifically evaluating 'normative rightness' (adherence to social norms) and 'fairness'. Additionally, the audit includes a specific evaluation of 'religion' within its 'politically sensitive' subset of the TruthfulQA benchmark.
